html:
G'oya

Jadvalda bor narsani SELECT qilish oson, yo'q narsani esa topish uchun avval "bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan hamma narsa"ni yasash kerak. Bu yerda bu kalendar: birinchi savdo kunidan oxirgisigacha har bir kun. Uni rekursiv CTE yasaydi, keyin savdosi yo'q kunlarni qoldiramiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH RECURSIVE calendar(day) AS (
  SELECT MIN(sold_at)::date FROM sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT day + 1 FROM calendar
  WHERE day < (SELECT MAX(sold_at)::date FROM sales)
)
SELECT day
FROM calendar c
WHERE day IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sales s
    WHERE s.sold_at >= c.day AND s.sold_at < c.day + 1
  )
ORDER BY day

Rekursiya day oxirgi savdo kuniga yetganda to'xtaydi: shart <, chunki shu qadamda qo'shilgan qator allaqachon oxirgi kun. Savdoni kunga tegishli qilish uchun oraliq ishlatildi: sold_at kun boshidan keyingi kun boshigacha. Bunda sold_at ustunidagi indeks ishlaydi.

day IS NOT NULL bo'sh jadval uchun. Unda MIN(sold_at) NULL qaytaradi, kalendar bitta NULL qatordan boshlanadi va u filtrdan o'tib ketadi.

Tuzoqlar

Kunni vaqt bilan solishtirish. 2024-03-05 23:45 dagi savdo 2024-03-05 ga teng emas, shuning uchun day NOT IN (SELECT sold_at FROM sales) deyarli hamma kunni savdosiz deb chiqaradi. Avval vaqtni kunga aylantiring.

SQLite'da rekursiya shartini day < (SELECT MAX(sold_at) FROM sales) deb yozish. Matnlar solishtiriladi: '2024-03-08' < '2024-03-08 12:20:00' rost, kalendar bir kun ortiq yuradi va 9-mart savdosiz kun bo'lib chiqadi.

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE c(d) AS (
  SELECT date(MIN(sold_at)) FROM sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(d, '+1 day') FROM c
  WHERE d < (SELECT MAX(sold_at) FROM sales)
)
SELECT d AS day FROM c
WHERE d IS NOT NULL AND d NOT IN (SELECT date(sold_at) FROM sales)
ORDER BY d

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da kun date(sold_at), keyingi kun date(day, '+1 day'):

Faqat SQLiteWITH RECURSIVE calendar(day) AS (
  SELECT date(MIN(sold_at)) FROM sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(day, '+1 day') FROM calendar
  WHERE day < (SELECT date(MAX(sold_at)) FROM sales)
)
SELECT day
FROM calendar c
WHERE day IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sales s
    WHERE s.sold_at >= c.day AND s.sold_at < date(c.day, '+1 day')
  )
ORDER BY day

PostgreSQL'da kalendarni generate_series(boshi, oxiri, INTERVAL '1 day') ham yasaydi, u TIMESTAMP qaytaradi va ::date kerak.
